ruleDefinitions.name: PsExec/PAExec Escalation to LOCAL SYSTEM
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious commandline flags used by PsExec and PAExec to escalate a command line to LOCAL_SYSTEM rights

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ \\-i\\ cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-i\\ \\-s\\ cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ pwsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ \\-i\\ pwsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-i\\ \\-s\\ pwsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ \\-i\\ powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-i\\ \\-s\\ powershell.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*psexec.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*paexec.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*accepteula.*")))
